newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Troops in Kabila's Congo fire in air, block march.
newsitem.headline: Troops in Kabila's Congo fire in air, block march.

text.p: Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila's troops fired two shots in the air and blocked a protest on Saturday by students against the new government in the Democratic Republic of Congo, witnesses said.
Witnesses said many of about 1,000 protesters, heading for the city centre, were panicked by the sound of the gunfire and scattered. But a group of about 200 continued the march.

The demonstration, the second in two days, was started by students protesting against Kabila's exclusion of veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi from his new government and the presence of Rwandan troops among his forces.

Kabila's rebel alliance took power in Kinshasa a week ago after a seven-month guerrilla war to drive out President Mobutu Sese Seko, who dominated Africa's third largest country, formerly known as Zaire, for over three decades.
